title: refactor(core,objectql,plugin-sharing): one PackageScopedNameRefusedError class for every package-scoped by-name refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Pd2vxfndbHVQLiX3wzkDSN)_
Fixes #31852

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/core` and the lean entry `@objectstack/objectql/core` gain `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：包作用域按名读取被拒时抛出的 `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` 原本在 objectql 和 plugin-sharing 各有一份，现在只在 `@objectstack/core` 声明一次，两个包原名转出同一个类；objectql 的精简入口 `@objectstack/objectql/core` 也导出它。导航翻译检查脚本遇到同名应用被拒时，改为报一条列出所有候选包的组合错误，不再抛出 409 中断。
- 为什么改：两份同名类互不 `instanceof`，以后谁要捕获"包作用域名字冲突"就得猜用哪一份，猜错一半；精简入口的使用者只能按 code 和 status 匹配。
- 风险与回滚：每个入口仍返回 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`、同一句话，行为不变；plugin-sharing 抛出的错误多带一个值相同的 `httpStatus` 字段。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`（类本体）、`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/package-scoped-declarations.ts`（改为转出）、`packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs`（`readMergedApp`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/package-scoped-declarations.test.ts`，预期 26 个全过，其中 3 个是本 PR 新增的跨包 `instanceof` 断言。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/core`** (`package-scoped-resolution.ts`): `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` is declared here once, beside `PackageScopedRefusal` and `packageScopedRefusalMessage`. It carries the union of the two old copies' fields: `code = 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`, `status = 409`, `httpStatus = 409` and `refusal`, and its message is the refusal's own sentence. Core's barrel already re-exports the module (`export *`), so no barrel edit.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`** (`package-scoped-read.ts`): the local class is gone; the module re-exports core's binding under the same name, so the barrel, `metadata-facade.ts` and `registry.ts` keep their imports.
- **`@objectstack/objectql/core`** (lean entry, `core.ts`): exports the class too, since the `SchemaRegistry` it exports throws it from `getApp`. Core is already in the entry's closure, so `core-boundary.ratchet.test.ts` stays green.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-sharing`** (`package-scoped-declarations.ts`): the local class is gone; the module re-exports core's binding under the same name, so `sharing-rule-service.ts` and `ownership-queue-service.ts` keep their imports. Its refusals gain `httpStatus: 409`.
- **`packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs`** (N1): the app is read through a new pure `readMergedApp(name, getApp, isRefusal)`. A `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` from `registry.getApp(name)` becomes a composition finding naming the app and every candidate, reported beside the gate's other composition errors (so the coverage verdict is not attempted). It never reads as "not registered", whose remedy is the opposite. Any other error is rethrown untouched. I chose "catch and report" over "read by the shell's package": a read naming the shell package would silently pick the shell's app and hide a real name clash from the gate.

Measured site census (delta ruling 1), `git grep -n "PackageScopedNameRefusedError\|RESOURCE_CONFLICT.*refusal"` on `origin/main` `074a014c`: two declarations (objectql `package-scoped-read.ts`, plugin-sharing `package-scoped-declarations.ts`); throws in `package-scoped-read.ts`, `sharing-rule-service.ts` (2) and `ownership-queue-service.ts` (2); `instanceof` in `metadata-facade.ts`, `sharing-rule-service.ts` and `ownership-queue-service.ts` (2). No third copy on main. Open PRs read at their heads: E3 #31815 adds no site. plugin-email #31825 adds a separate class, `EmailTemplateAmbiguousError` (same 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` envelope, different name, extra `template` and `candidates` fields), in `plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts`. It is left to that PR's seat, as ruled.

Changeset: `.changeset/31852-one-package-scoped-refusal-class.md`, patch for core, objectql and plugin-sharing. `@objectstack/cli` takes none: its `files` is `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, so `scripts/` does not publish.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`: the class carries `code`, `status`, `httpStatus`, `refusal` and the refusal's sentence.
- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`: `toBe` identity of the class from `package-scoped-read.js`, the barrel and the lean `./core` entry against core's; a `getApp` refusal is `instanceof` the lean entry's class.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/package-scoped-declarations.test.ts`: `toBe` identity of plugin-sharing's and objectql's export against core's; a refusal from objectql's by-name reader (`SchemaRegistry#getApp`) is `instanceof` plugin-sharing's class, and a refusal from plugin-sharing's door (`SharingRuleService#declaredRuleNamed`) is `instanceof` objectql's class.
- `check-app-nav-i18n.mjs --self-test`: six new cases for `readMergedApp` (refusal becomes a finding, names every candidate, never reads as unregistered; served and unregistered reads unchanged; a non-refusal error is rethrown, as a negative control; the boot read passes the class test).
- Wire envelope (delta ruling 5) already pinned by existing tests, unchanged: objectql `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` ("the refusal crosses a wire door as 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT") and plugin-sharing `package-scoped-declarations.test.ts` ("refuses the sharing rule by name with 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT naming both packages").

No existing test was edited or deleted.

## Acceptance notes

- plugin-email #31825 adds `EmailTemplateAmbiguousError`, a third class for the same refusal family. Not touched here (ruling 1); its seat decides whether it extends or reuses this class.
